editorial:
Imagine putting in all your hard work to create the biggest hit of the year, only to have your boss kick you out the door a week later. That is exactly what happens to the main guy in this flick. He is a young, hungry ad exec who finally hits the jackpot with a brilliant campaign, but the corporate world is cruel. You will feel for him as he tries to navigate the mess of being famous for his work while having no job to show for it. The vibe is light, funny, and feels like a classic late-90s workplace comedy where everything that can go wrong does.

The pacing is quick, so you will not get bored, and the acting makes the characters feel like real people you might actually know. While some of the jokes are a bit dated, the overall story is still super relatable if you have ever felt cheated at work. If you want to see this in the best quality possible, you should definitely look for the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection. If you are in a rush, renting it on Apple TV is a great way to catch it for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the end, the main character manages to prove that his original ideas were the only reason the company succeeded. He exposes his boss for stealing his credit during a big public event. Instead of begging for his old job back, he starts his own agency. The twist is that the clients leave the big firm to follow him. He ends up wealthier and more successful than he ever was as an employee.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves underdog stories and office humor.
